draft.title: Token to Goal: 3 by 3 Grid Puzzle
draft.description: A flat 3 by 3 board of light tiles seen from above and in front. A red sphere token starts on the bottom-left square; a green raised disc marks the goal on the top-right square. Up, Down, Left and Right buttons move the token one square. Hint shows an orange arrow from the token toward a square one step closer to the goal. Readouts show moves made and steps still needed.

game.objective: Move the token from the bottom-left square to the green goal square on the top-right.
game.hint: Each move changes either the row or the column by one. The goal is 2 squares right and 2 squares up, so the shortest route takes 4 moves.

assumptions: This is a simple made-up puzzle, not a model of anything real.
The token moves only up, down, left or right, never diagonally, so 'steps to goal' counts the up/down steps plus the left/right steps (taxicab distance).
The token starts on the bottom-left square and the goal is the top-right square, so the shortest route takes 4 moves.
Once the token reaches the goal, the game is won and the move buttons stop working until you press Reset.
Up means away from the camera's starting view and Right means to the right of it. A move off the board does nothing. Reset always returns to the same start; it never picks a new start or goal.
